nodes.title: Instruction for the image describer
widgets_values: Maximum 350 words. Describe the image as a single detailed paragraph for an image generator. Be literal and precise. Cover: 1) camera angle and distance (height, tilt, lens), 2) the pose and the position of each arm and hand, 3) the head turn, gaze direction and facial expression using concrete features (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), 4) hair, skin, makeup, 5) each clothing item and how it is worn, 6) every background object and where it sits, 7) lighting direction, colors and atmosphere, 8) the rendering style and texture. No speculation, no opinions, no text or resolution mentions.
